stationScope.evidence: CITYWATT's current official Ladenetz page states that CHARGE@CITYWATT is valid at all CITYWATT stations, has no monthly base fee, and currently costs 0.45 EUR/kWh for AC up to 22 kW and 0.59 EUR/kWh for DC. Current public station-level data independently identifies DE*CIW EVSEs, including DE*CIW*E001484 through DE*CIW*E001496 at Grafenauer Straße 16, Eging am See, and DE*CIW*E000589 through DE*CIW*E000600 at Friedrich-Rätzer-Straße 5, Schweinfurt. The prefix is recorded as observed identity evidence; application remains restricted to physical CITYWATT-operated stations.

roamingDeferred.reason: CITYWATT explicitly states that CHARGE@EU prices at other operators vary by charge point and are shown in the app; no roaming tariff is propagated to third-party CPOs.

adHocDeferred.reason: Public station-level ad-hoc prices can differ from CHARGE@CITYWATT and are not inferred from this direct CPO offer. They remain station/EVSE-specific until a verified QR/direct-payment price is available.

note: Current direct CITYWATT tariff from the operator's official Ladenetz page. The historical 0.39 EUR/kWh promotional tariff ended on 9 August 2026 and is not modeled. No blocking fee is added because none is published as a universal component of CHARGE@CITYWATT on the current tariff page.
